user_message.content: Make a copy of AptCorp Reports - OneSite & Yardi

status_update.description: Manus is working on your request

assistant_message.content:
This **independent copy** is ready for its own workstream. It includes the AptCorp Property Reports portal’s source code and database schema, while its database starts empty and it has its own deployment and checkpoint history.

| Area | Included in this copy |
|---|---|
| Core portal | Property-level delinquency reporting, report requests, document archiving, and a filed-workbook **My Reports** workspace |
| Access control | Manus OAuth with admin, boss, and manager role flows plus approval-oriented access controls |
| OneSite | A 45-report approved catalog, report-selection interface, and OneSite request/filing workflows |
| Current reporting policy | Current-resident delinquency reporting, with portal-facing prepaid information removed |
| Navigation | **Pull Reports – OneSite** first, **Pull Reports – Yardi** second; Yardi remains a non-configured placeholder |
| Technical foundation | React + TypeScript + Vite frontend; Node.js/Express + tRPC backend; MySQL/Drizzle schema; S3-compatible document storage |

The copied `todo.md` remains available as historical context, but I will not continue or add items from it unless you explicitly direct me to do so.

What would you like to build, verify, or change next in this copy?
